properties.name: reflow2's skills, served and installed, conform to the Agent Skills specification (agentskills.io), and the skill lint checks it
properties.statement:
Anthony, 2026-09-28: "For skills, we should consider: https://agentskills.io/specification." Kept as intent the same day.

Every reflow2 skill conforms to the Agent Skills specification:
· the source in getting-started/skills;
· the copies the kit installs (.claude/skills, .grok/skills);
· the text served by get_skill.
reflow2's own additions (metadata such as composes, audience, summary and the shortcut) are carried in the way the specification allows for extensions, never in a way that breaks a conforming reader. tools/skill_lint.py, which already enforces reflow2's own skill contracts, also checks conformance to the specification, so a skill that drifts from it fails the build.

A NEW REVISION of the specification is adopted deliberately, as for MCP: read it, list what changed, check the skills against it, and record the result. How revisions are watched is req:the-hub-tracks-the-standards-reflow2-and-flo2-follow-and-reviews-each-new-revision in the hub's design.
